# Annotate

> Annotate lets a person frame part of a web page in Chrome, write a note, and send it to Claude Code, which does it and marks it done with one line. It needs Google Chrome, Claude Code 2.1.296 or later and an Annotate account (invite-only for now). Connecting needs only a browser sign-in and one Allow click: never ask for, print or store a token or key.

Connect with the one line, which installs the Annotate plugin from Annotate's website and opens the browser:

```sh
claude plugin install annotate --marketplace https://annotate-app.fly.dev/plugin/marketplace.json && claude mcp login plugin:annotate:annotate
```

Without the plugin, in the project the person wants Claude to work on:

```sh
claude mcp add --transport http annotate https://annotate-app.fly.dev/mcp
claude mcp login annotate
```

The browser opens; the person signs in if asked and clicks Allow. Then they add the Annotate extension from the Chrome Web Store and pin it.

To help the person:
- Run `/mcp`; if annotate needs authentication, run `claude mcp login plugin:annotate:annotate` (or `claude mcp login annotate` without the plugin) again.
- When asked to take Annotate frames, call frames_next, do what the note and picture ask, then frame_mark done with one plain sentence.
- If ⇧⌘F does nothing, have them check Annotate is on in chrome://extensions and reload the page.
- If it's still broken, have them send Feedback from the website's menu, in their own words.
